target.title: policy: preview review-required tool repairs
target.body:
## Summary
- Restacked on current `main` after #99731 merged and #99776 was split to the gateway-only preview commit.
- Extends policy doctor review-required repair previews from Gateway findings into agent/tool posture findings.
- Wires previews for agent workspace access, tool profile, fs workspace-only, exec security, exec ask, and exec host checks.
- Adds registered-check coverage proving previews are skipped review-required repairs and do not mutate config.

## Real behavior proof
Behavior or issue addressed:
`doctor --fix` surfaces review-required preview guidance for agent/tool policy findings without mutating config or counting the check as repaired.

Real environment tested:
Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-policy-review-previews-push`, source checkout at PR head `9001d430`, rebased on upstream `main` `6235344006` after #99731 merged.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `git diff --check policy-doctor-review-required-previews..policy-doctor-tools-agent-previews`
2. `rg -n "<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>" extensions/policy/src/doctor src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts`
3. `git diff --stat policy-doctor-review-required-previews..policy-doctor-tools-agent-previews`
4. `git log --oneline --decorate --graph upstream/main..policy-doctor-tools-agent-previews`

Evidence after fix:
Whitespace check exited 0. Conflict marker search returned no matches. The follow-up diff over #99776 is three files and 264 insertions: registered policy tests, additional review-required repair metadata, and tool scope wiring. The cleaned stack is two commits: `842b5605 policy: preview review-required gateway repairs`, then `9001d430 policy: preview review-required tool repairs`.

Observed result after fix:
Registered tool/agent policy findings now produce skipped review-required preview repairs with warning/change text and dry-run-safe config effects; they do not directly mutate config.

What was not tested:
Focused Vitest was not rerun locally because this clean push worktree has no `node_modules`. GitHub CI is running on pushed PR head `9001d430`.

## Stack
- Stacked after #99776 (`policy: preview review-required gateway repairs`).
- Leaves `tools.alsoAllow` for a follow-up slice because that can widen or remove explicit tool permissions.
